comments.text:
## Blocked: JavaScript-based PDF Links

The North Carolina slip opinions page (https://appellate.nccourts.org/opinion-filings/?c=coa) uses JavaScript onclick handlers to generate PDF links dynamically. The PDF IDs are not present in the HTML - they are injected via JavaScript.

**What works:**
- Metadata extraction (case names, docket numbers, authors, headnotes, publication status, dates)
- ZIP file downloads containing all opinions for a date are available via direct URLs

**What does not work:**
- Individual PDF URLs cannot be scraped because they are generated by JavaScript
- The PDF ID (e.g., 44963 in ?c=2&pdf=44963) is not in the HTML

**Possible solutions:**
1. Use ZIP downloads: Download bundled PDFs by date instead of individual files
2. Use Playwright driver: Execute JavaScript to extract PDF URLs (requires PlaywrightDriver)
3. Find alternative data source: Look for RSS feed or API endpoint

**Files created:**
- juriscraper/sd/state/north_carolina/appellate_nccourts_org/__init__.py
- juriscraper/sd/state/north_carolina/appellate_nccourts_org/models.py
- juriscraper/sd/state/north_carolina/appellate_nccourts_org/scraper.py

The scraper infrastructure is in place and will work once PDF URL extraction is solved.

title: Add Alabama appellate courts scraper (publicportal.alappeals.gov)
description:
## Overview
Add a scraper for Alabama appellate courts using the new public portal at https://publicportal.alappeals.gov/

## Courts to Support
- **Alabama Supreme Court** (court_id: `ala`, GUID: `68f021c4-6a44-4735-9a76-5360b2e8af13`)
- **Alabama Court of Civil Appeals** (court_id: `alactapp`, GUID: `1da1a297-c391-4e4f-9480-1bc68b46f21a`)
- **Alabama Court of Criminal Appeals** (court_id: `alacrimapp`, GUID: `b82b30d5-bd3c-46d7-9451-1cb05e470873`)

## Data Types Available
1. **Dockets/Cases** - Full case information with parties, documents, filings
2. **Opinions/Decisions** - Weekly release lists with links to opinion PDFs
3. **Oral Arguments** - Scheduled oral arguments with case details

## Portal URL Patterns

### Case Search
- Search page: `/portal/search/case`
- Search results: `/portal/search/case/results?criteria=...`
- Case detail: `/portal/court/{court-guid}/case/{case-guid}`

### Decision Search (Opinions)
- Search page: `/portal/search/publication`
- Search results: `/portal/search/publication/results?criteria=...`
- Release list: `/portal/court/{court-guid}/publication/{publication-guid}`
- Document download: `https://publicportal-api.alappeals.gov/courts/{court-guid}/cms/case/{case-guid}/docketentrydocuments/{doc-guid}`

### Oral Arguments Search
- Search page: `/portal/search/calendar`
- Results show scheduled oral arguments with links to cases

## Case Detail Page Structure
- **Header**: Case number, title, classification, filed date, originating court
- **Parties section**: Party name, role (Appellant/Appellee), representation (attorneys), status
- **Tabs**:
  - Documents: Filing date, type, subtype, description, view link
  - Parties: Full party/attorney details
  - Oral Arguments: Scheduled arguments

## Decision/Opinion Structure
- Decisions are grouped into weekly "Release Lists"
- Each release grouped by authoring Justice/Judge
- Decision entries show: case number (link), case title, outcome, document links

## Current Justices/Judges

### Alabama Supreme Court
- Chief Justice: Sarah H. Stewart
- Associate Justices: Greg Shaw, Kelli Wise, Tommy Bryan, William B. Sellers, Brady E. Mendheim Jr., Greg Cook, Chris McCool, Will Parker
- Clerk: Megan B. Rhodebeck

### Court of Civil Appeals
- Presiding Judge: Terry A. Moore
- Judges: Christy O. Edwards, Chad A. Hanson, Matt Fridy, Ben Bowden
- Clerk: Seth Rhodebeck

### Court of Criminal Appeals
- Presiding Judge: Mary B. Windom
- Judges: J. Elizabeth Kellum, J. William Cole, Richard J. Minor, Richard D. Anderson
- Clerk: D. Scott Mitchell

## Important Notes
- **Document access**: Documents filed on/after March 20, 2022 available on Public Portal
- **Decisions split**: Opinions before May 19, 2023 at judicial.alabama.gov (links to acis.alabama.gov)
- **Decisions after May 19, 2023** at publicportal.alappeals.gov
- **Registration**: Document viewing requires registration, but docket access is public
- **Oral Arguments**: YouTube channels available for live streams

## Implementation Plan
1. Create models.py with:
   - AlaDocket, AlaDocketEntry - case/docket models
   - AlaOpinionCluster, AlaOpinion - decision models  
   - AlaOralArgument - oral argument model
   - Court ID mappings

2. Create scraper.py with steps:
   - Case search pagination
   - Case detail parsing (parties, documents)
   - Decision/release list parsing
   - Oral arguments parsing
   - Document downloads via ArchiveRequest

3. Create XSDs documenting page structures

## References
- Public Portal: https://publicportal.alappeals.gov/
- Supreme Court: https://judicial.alabama.gov/Appellate/SupremeCourt
- Civil Appeals: https://judicial.alabama.gov/Appellate/CivilAppeals
- Criminal Appeals: https://judicial.alabama.gov/Appellate/CriminalAppeals
- User Guide PDF: https://judicial.alabama.gov/docs/PublicPortalUserGuide.pdf

Judge/Justice biographical information is available on the judicial.alabama.gov website, NOT the public portal.

### URL Pattern for Judge Bios


### Known Judge IDs

**Alabama Supreme Court:**

**Other Staff:**
| Name | Role | ID |
|------|------|-----|
| Reporter of Decisions | 67 |
| State Law Librarian | 23 |
| Marshal | 62 |

### Scraping Strategy for Judges
1. **Source pages**: Scrape judge lists from court overview pages:
   - https://judicial.alabama.gov/Appellate/SupremeCourt
   - https://judicial.alabama.gov/Appellate/CivilAppeals
   - https://judicial.alabama.gov/Appellate/CriminalAppeals

2. **Bio pages**: For each judge, fetch their bio page to extract:
   - Full name
   - Title/position
   - Photo URL
   - Biography text
   - Education
   - Career history

3. **Linking to opinions**: The decision release lists group cases by authoring judge name (e.g., "Sellers, J.", "McCool, J."). Match these to the judge records.

### Note on Judge Names in Decisions
In the public portal decision releases, judges are referenced by last name + honorific:
- "Sellers, J." = Justice William B. Sellers
- "McCool, J." = Justice Chris McCool
- etc.

Create a mapping from these short forms to full judge records.
